message.reasoning_content: Round 5 action, then round 6 market last chance to sell. I hold license (20-60 alashi extra). Promissory 38.75 won't be redeemed after round 6? "After last round promissory not redeemed" — round 6 market sell_credit proceeds won't pay out. But round 6 market sells for cash. So get goods now to sell in round 6 market. Shuttle gives 3 goods (already had 3 grey sold). Price counter at 3, prices low (~8). Shuttle free, gives 3 goods. Shuttle (choice 3) gives 3, produce gives 2. Shuttle better and no seizure at black tariff? Risk 25% loss. Expected 2.25 goods vs 2 from produce. Slight edge; but full loss risk. Take shuttle.
